task.title: Deployment Strategy Cleanup and Production-Grade Redeployment
task.objective: Establish a clean, reproducible, and production-grade deployment process by first auditing the existing deployment script, removing any prior broken or ad-hoc deployment state, and then implementing best-practice deployment procedures.

step.title: Review Existing Deployment Script
step.description:
The first priority is to inspect the current deployment logic.
- Open and analyze `deploy.sh` as the single source of truth. - Understand all existing deployment steps (build, install, run, env setup, migrations). - Identify any legacy, duplicated, or unsafe deployment behavior.
step.rule: Do NOT introduce new deployment logic before fully understanding `deploy.sh`.

step.title: Remove Previous Deployment State
step.description:
Before applying any new deployment strategy:
- Remove all previously deployed artifacts on the server. - Stop any running services related to the old deployment. - Clear outdated builds, containers, or processes. - Ensure the system is in a clean, reproducible baseline state.
step.rule: Do not layer new deployment on top of existing broken or unknown states.

step.title: Implement Clean Deployment Pipeline
step.description:
Rebuild deployment using a deterministic and production-safe strategy:
Core principles: - Single-command deployment via `deploy.sh`. - Idempotent execution (safe to run multiple times). - Explicit environment separation (dev / staging / production).

best_practices.item: Environment Variables: - Use `.env` or secure environment injection. - Never hardcode secrets in scripts.
Build Process: - Clean build on each deployment. - Avoid stale caches unless explicitly required.
Process Management: - Use systemd, pm2, or equivalent process manager. - Ensure auto-restart on crash.
Database Safety: - Run migrations explicitly and safely. - Ensure backward-compatible schema changes where possible.
Zero-Downtime Strategy: - Prefer rolling restart or blue-green deployment where feasible. - Avoid full service downtime during updates.
Logging and Observability: - Centralize logs. - Ensure deployment logs are stored and traceable.
Health Checks: - Add post-deploy health check endpoint validation. - Fail deployment if health checks fail.

step.title: Post-Deployment Verification
step.description:
After deployment completes:
- Verify service uptime. - Confirm authentication flow works. - Validate API endpoints. - Ensure no regression from previous version.

deliverables.item: Removed legacy deployment artifacts and state.

engineering_principles.item: Always start from a clean state.
